features: Full HD 1080p video with live viewing
Black and white night vision for low-light conditions
Dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4/5 GHz, 802.11 b/g/n) with Bluetooth 4.2 for setup
Motion detection with up to 10 customizable motion/privacy zones
Cloud-based AI object recognition plus optional local AI models
Privacy (blackout) zones and hardware Privacy Mode
WebRTC peer-to-peer live viewing and RTSP local streaming to DVR/NVR
Local microSD recording, downloadable MP4, optional EU-based Shelly Cloud storage
Manually adjustable pan and tilt; magnetic base with adhesive metal plate
Scripting, MQTT and webhooks (URL actions) support

frigate.notes: Officially listed as compatible with Frigate NVR via RTSP local streaming (exact RTSP stream URL provided in the Shelly web interface / app).

home_assistant.notes: Officially supported integration with Home Assistant; also exposes local RTSP/WebRTC and MQTT.

blue_iris.notes: Compatible with RTSP-based DVR/NVR software such as Blue Iris via its local RTSP stream.
